# UREfy

> UREfy is a web social platform for public community discussions and encrypted direct conversations. The official website is https://urefy.com/.

## Product and practical guides

- [About UREfy](https://urefy.com/about): What the platform is and how key-based identity differs from hosted infrastructure.
- [Features](https://urefy.com/features): Community posts, replies, encrypted direct messages, Vault and browser support.
- [Frequently asked questions](https://urefy.com/faq): Accounts, email requirements, public visibility, installation and recovery.
- [Getting started](https://urefy.com/guides/get-started): Read discussions, create an identity and protect recovery material.
- [Private messaging](https://urefy.com/guides/private-messaging): Encryption boundaries, recipients and device precautions.
- [Security](https://urefy.com/security): Current implementation and limitations, without a claim of independent certification.
- [Privacy](https://urefy.com/privacy): Public data, encryption and cookie-free performance monitoring.
- [Terms](https://urefy.com/terms): Rules for using the service.

## Public discovery

- [Explore](https://urefy.com/explore): Recent public discussions and people.
- [Communities](https://urefy.com/communities): Current community directory; use its real links rather than assuming a topic exists.
- [Sitemap](https://urefy.com/sitemap.xml): Canonical public routes and paginated sitemaps.
- [Expanded reference](https://urefy.com/llms-full.txt): A concise factual product reference.

## Important boundaries

UREfy runs in modern web browsers; PWA installation depends on browser support. No native store-app availability is asserted here. The current identity flow does not require an email or phone number. Public posts, replies and profiles can be indexed. Direct-message content, private Vault data and user recovery keys are not public discovery material.

Direct messages use client-side end-to-end encryption. This does not conceal every network or routing detail, protect a compromised endpoint, or prevent a recipient copying content. Infrastructure backups cannot replace lost user-only keys. UREfy uses sampled, cookie-free performance monitoring and operational security logs; it does not claim that no operational data is processed.

Updated: 30 September 2026. This file is a reading aid; the linked live pages and actual public content are the source for product claims.
